description: Work out what settling or overpaying costs as of a period: the outstanding balance, the penalty if one is given, the recalculated remaining schedule and the interest saved, stated gross and net of the penalty. Pro.

as_of_period.description: The period the extra money is paid at the end of. Period 1 is the first payment

extra_minor.description: A partial overpayment in whole minor units. Omit to settle the loan in full

keep_payment.description: On a partial overpayment, keep the same payment and shorten the term. Default false, which keeps the term and lowers the payment

limit.description: Maximum remaining rows to return, ceiling 600

loan.description: The loan id, e.g. LOAN-2026-0001, or its exact name

penalty_minor.description: Early repayment charge in whole minor units. Default 0

name: loan_repay_early
title: Settle or overpay a loan early
